pythonFunction.name: set_session_state
pythonFunction.description: Writes one or more key-value pairs to session state. Used by the trigger pattern: the LLM calls this tool to set _action_trigger (e.g., 'escalate_to_advisor') or update state variables like auth_attempt_count and discovery_state fields. The before_model_callback reads _action_trigger on the next model call and executes the action deterministically, bypassing the LLM.
